rank_rule: Affix ranks correspond to distinct effective source-value tiers, not every original rarity. Identical values on adjacent source rarities are collapsed (32 affixes affected). If deterministic maximum roll or native effect caps make further steps indistinguishable, omit those additional paid ranks before implementation. Source rarities are preserved as provenance, not all separate paid levels.

creative_flight_exception: Apotheosis Unbound has neoforge:creative_flight; Monk Unbound must NOT supply this; only enhance Draconic Curio supplied flight.
